name: MERIDIAN: Transfer Funds
description: Signs on to MERIDIAN CORE, moves funds between a member's own shares (review -> post), and reports the confirmation number.

inputParams.name: username
inputParams.description: Operator ID used to sign on.

inputParams.name: password
inputParams.description: Operator password used to sign on.

inputParams.name: branch
inputParams.description: Branch to sign on at (e.g. MAIN-001).

inputParams.name: memberId
inputParams.description: The member whose shares to transfer between.

inputParams.name: fromShare
inputParams.description: Exact share id to move funds OUT of, e.g. "100234-S0001" -- MERIDIAN identifies shares by id, not a fixed checking/savings pair.

inputParams.name: toShare
inputParams.description: Exact share id to move funds INTO, e.g. "100234-S0070".

inputParams.name: amount
inputParams.description: Dollar amount to transfer. Plain numeric value, no currency symbol.

inputParams.name: memo
inputParams.description: Optional memo text for this transfer.
